rows.notes: Awaiting certified degree translation from Japanese to German.

rows.description: Register employee with Finanzamt and obtain Steueridentifikationsnummer.
rows.notes: Cannot start until work permit is issued.

rows.title: Singapore Employment Pass Application

rows.notes: On hold pending case approval from Finance.

rows.title: UK Skilled Worker Visa Application
rows.description: Apply for Skilled Worker visa under UK Points-Based System. Employer sponsorship confirmed.
rows.notes: Biometrics appointment booked at VFS in Bangalore.

rows.description: Conduct right-to-work verification per UK Home Office guidance once visa is issued.

rows.title: International School Search — Dubai
rows.description: Identify and shortlist IB curriculum schools in Dubai for one school-age dependent.

rows.title: French Long-Stay Visa (Salarié)
rows.description: Apply for French long-stay visa for salaried employee. Requires valid passport.
rows.notes: BLOCKED: Passport expires before visa validity period. Renewal in progress.

rows.title: Australian Employer Nomination Scheme (ENS) Visa
rows.description: Lodge ENS subclass 186 visa for permanent employer-sponsored relocation.
rows.notes: Visa granted for employee and all dependants.

rows.title: Dutch Highly Skilled Migrant (HSM) Permit
rows.description: Apply for IND Highly Skilled Migrant permit under Dutch knowledge migrant route.
rows.notes: IND processing time approximately 2–3 weeks under fast track.

rows.title: BSN Registration (DigiD & Municipality)
rows.description: Register at Amsterdam municipality for BSN number within 5 days of arrival.
rows.notes: Appointment at Stadsloket must be booked in advance.
